outcome: composite outcome of mental health service utilization (diagnosis of depressive disorder, diagnosis of anxiety disorder, visit to a behavioral health service provider, and/or psychiatric admission)
healthcare provider referral to a behavioral health service provider
cohort: The study included 3478 pregnant women from a public hospital in New York City, grouped by the language they spoke (English, Spanish, Russian, and Urdu/Bengali/Punjabi).
finding: Russian language was associated with lower utilization of mental health services and lower rates of referral to behavioral health postpartum compared to other language groups.
